description: Acterys Copy is a custom Power BI visual for planning that enhances your Power BI scenario planning and forecasting processes. It allows users to copy data between scenarios in Power BI, streamlining workflows by reusing historical or actuals-based data to build future plans. Whether working at the model level or focusing on specific dimensions like cost centers or products, this data copy Power BI visual ensures agility and consistency across your planning efforts. With full integration into Acterys' advanced features, including Power BI write-back visuals and comprehensive planning tools, Acterys Copy empowers organizations to build accurate forecasts and maintain centralized scenario control—all from within Power BI. Acterys delivers robust solutions that simplify planning and forecasting in Power BI, making financial and operational decision-making faster, easier, and more reliable. Key Features: Persistent Scenario Management: Centrally store and manage all scenarios in SQL Server for consistent and reliable data access across planning cycles. Flexible Data Copying: Effortlessly copy data between scenarios in Power BI, using past actuals to quickly build new plans. Dimension-Specific Copying: Target key areas like cost centers, departments, or products for more focused and precise scenario planning.
